pages: Surely not... Sieger!
You don't mean to set off after Mizuki, do you?!
Attacking Paris, the impregnable fortress city, from underground...
That St. Germain has no sense of decency at all!
Whaaat?! The ball's totally ruined?
Queen Antoinette is a demon?
The palace is in shambles?
An evil Arc de Triomphe showed up?
Ugh! I don't get it at all!
So the Arc de Triomphe is like, a new tourist spot now...
But it's kinda scary, so I haven't gone yet...
Like, you know?
French bread is tres bien! Come again!
You feel a little stamina return.
Queen Antoinette came here from a foreign land to marry...
Perhaps she was lonely, with no true friends at the palace.
No money? Oh well, what can you do.
Non! Come to France and not eat bread?
That is a crime, aru...
Oops, I mean, a crime!
Tasty, yes? Fresh from the oven!
Your spirit rose a little!
Master Lou is the famous head of the Phantom Conjurers troupe.
He is a kind man, but scary when angry.
They say he helped form the European Allied Army, too.
Yes, sir! Long live the Emperor!
Hahaha, it's true! I'm glad we took Lou up on his offer.
Tch... cheap booze after all...
If I'd taken Lou up on his offer, I'd be...
Hmph... Go wag your tail at him now, then.
Why, if it isn't Lord Haohmaru!
Why, if it isn't Lord Ukyo!
What can I do for you?
Anything else?
That's plenty for you.
This person, then?
How much should I forge it?
Is there anything else?
Which one will it be?
Nobody can equip this!
Equip it?
You can't hold any more money!
You have nothing to sell!
Head east down this road and you'll find an old temple.
They say it's haunted, so folks call it the Ghost Temple.
More importantly, demons are after Paris?
Is that true?
I came all this way to see it, and there's no Eiffel Tower yet?
Seriously? I can't believe it!
Like, you know?
You like crocodile meat?
Me like banana better than crocodile meat!
French bread is tres bien! Come again!
You feel a little stamina return.
Do you know the Ghost Temple? It's east of the palace road.
It was a monastery long ago, but now nobody's there.
Because they say it's haunted, you see! Hahaha!
Tasty, yes? Fresh from the oven!
Your spirit rose a little!
Rumor says some fellow named Count St. Germain
is the boss of the bad guys.
He uses Magiscience, a fusion of sorcery and science, they say.
Ah, {NAME}... Do you seek power?
If you like, I can help you train in Master Lou's place.
31.question: Will you train?

pages: Then... try fighting this.
It is Sieger's shadow,
but even as a shadow it is as strong as the real one. Beware.
Oh, a splendid technique! I have seen it well!
That hidden skill shall be your fang against evil!
But never grow proud of your power. Walk the path you believe in.
Haohmaru learned the secret art
Tenha Senkuzan!
Nakoruru learned the secret art
Rera O Kamuy!
Galford learned the secret art
Plasma Drive!
Ukyo Tachibana learned the secret art
Hiken: Messatsu Mugasumi!

Onsatsujin!
Cham Cham learned the secret art
Circulus Cornu!
Charlotte learned the secret art
Ange Defense!
Kyoshiro Senryo learned the secret art
Moujishi Renbu!

Konru Rakuru!

Fusatsu Hozan!
Hmm? Oh!
What an avant-garde style!
Ooh! Marvelous! Marvelous! I'm in ecstasy! I simply must!
Normally it's 99999999GP, but for you, only 100GP!
44.question: Get new clothes?

pages: Well!
Eeeeeek!
You scorn my tres bien designs!
Hmph! Vermin who don't understand art
can just go away!
Well! Are you making fun of me?!
Eeeek! Mock me and I'll bite you!
Well! You don't even have 100GP?
Ooh, art always demands its price, you know!
Ohohohohoho!
Ohohohoho! Now! What do you think?
I already know your measurements by heart!
It should fit even better than your old outfit!
An outfit like this...
I can tailor it in the blink of an eye!
Ohohohoho!
This kind of design is my specialty!
You're giving off pheromones
that could knock any gentleman dead! Ohohohoho!
My darling Charlotte...
Ah... how lovely...
I tried my best to express your nobility and beauty,
but no beauty surpasses you yourself.
Ah... Charlotte! You are simply too dazzling!
Yeah... (I don't really get it.)
Wow... it's true! Fashionable even in a place like this!
So jealous! Sister, you look wonderful!
Truly beautiful...
Nakoruru, I'd love to see you in a party dress.
Hehe... thank you. Paris is a lovely place!
Getting a ninja outfit made in Paris...
That's surreal, and good!
...I see. Japanese in style, yet unlike any kimono.
...Truly the work of a master.
Hmm... now that you mention it... Yes, I like it.
Me not really get it, but it soft and comfy!
She make it match my Chonachona ears!
M-merci, madame... (This is why I didn't want to come!)
Hey, Charlotte, clothes from the real Paris sure suit you.
I-is that so... Hahaha...
Well! Charlotte? Who is this filthy man?
Ooooh...
Even the tailoring is different from Japan... Hmmm.
Oh my... Monsieur Kyoshiro...
For you, and you alone, half price...
Ooh, such a sturdy body! Such exotic makeup...
Every bit of you
stirs my very spirit...
Um... teehee... I'm still single, you know...
Nahahaha! I-is that so...
Naha, nahahaha...
Yay! New clothes!
Hehe... Rimururu, you look so pretty.
Really? Yay! Let's go for a walk outside later!
Reon... you...
No, it's nothing. Nothing at all...
Reon, when this is all over, please come to Paris again.
...I'd like to make some clothes for you...
Hehe... it's a promise. All right?
...Y-yes... thank you... very much.
I'm training here in Paris... I wanna see how far
the smithing I learned in Japan will get me abroad.
The world sure is big...
Well, this must be fate. I'll look at yours first.
I hear Japanese swordsmiths are excellent.
With a sword forged here,
I'll cut St. Germain down! Hahahaha!
The swords he forges are excellent... Everyone says so.
I've been waiting my turn for ages, too.
M-my turn still hasn't come!
Hurry up! The battle's already begun!
...Now it's a matter of pride!
I'll wait as long as it takes!
Madame Lavoisier's designs are Europe's best! The latest trend!
Queen Antoinette and royals and nobles of every nation
all wear clothes she designed!
Now that there's peace,
I really have to think about fashion!
Ahh... I want to wear Madame's clothes to the ball, too!
If I'd gone to the ball, I'd have been burnt to a crisp...
But I still want to go to a ball!
I am Paris's most tres bien fashion designer!
Madame Lavoisier!
Paris destroyed?
A demon attack?
Do you mean to say that has any
ill effect on my tres bien sense of style?! Eeeek!
Peace!
Tres bien!
Aaaaah! The inspiration is overflowing!
If I don't design at least one outfit soon, I'll simply die!
I am an astrologer...
From the stars racing across the heavens
I can read your fate...
Well? For 50GP, shall I read yours?
89.question: Get your fortune read?

pages: I see... That's fine too. It is your fate.
...I couldn't read how light your purse was.
Next time, then...
...Though not by nature, you've grown quite aggressive.
Is it endless unwanted battle? Your soul has grown fierce.
It seems battle has made your soul a fierce one...
...A very aggressive soul... Born of a love of strife?
A terribly fierce soul... Do the stars hate you so,
or do they love you?
Sharp, both cold and hot!
Your soul is dangerously aggressive.
Oh... how warm... Your soul is merciful as the Holy Mother.
Oh... to keep such compassion even in battle...
...Hot, and vast... Your souls are full of compassion.
Your soul leans toward compassion...
Deeply, deeply...
Oh! At the heart of a dry soul shines a star of mercy...
Truly a miracle.
Hmm... your compassion swells, seeking a way out...
Will it be fortune or misfortune?
Now then... Mercury has entered Aquarius...
A new encounter shall guide your fate.
Hmm... the moon in Pisces forms a good angle...
It says you should readily accept others' requests.
Oho, Venus has begun to retrograde in Scorpio...
Something is hidden in a lonely place.
Hmm... Mars has returned to Aries...
Signs of war, of great upheaval!
Peace shall be broken suddenly.
Do not let your guard down.
Oh, a time of great change!
Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars in Aries are forming a fierce alignment.
The sun holds the key to turning things around... likely you.
...I'm counting on you.
Hmm... the angle of Saturn and Mars has turned favorable...
It seems we may live in peace for a while...
But soon you shall lose a great star...
Be prepared.
By the way, Paris is at peace now, but
your journey's end still seems far off...
Yet a mysterious force of fate is at work in you,
one that lets you grow by overcoming trials.
...I hope for the best outcome.
Hmm... yes!
{NAME}?
Pardon me, Genjuro...! If you like, let us talk a while.
Might you tell me about your parents?
Charlotte... it seems you've been blessed with good friends.
So you came as well.
I'm not one for places like this.
Well, do enjoy yourselves.
Earth, you're gonna live a long life.
Hey, everyone... let's go.
Reon, what wrong? You feel bad?
Use Reon power to find it good!
Kiiiii... Kyuru...
I shall dispose of any who hinder Lord St. Germain! Kiii!
Now! Lord St. Germain! The De Marche Cannon!
With your blue, cold flame of love,
burn me to ashes along with the palace!
Whoa! Ow!
Nyaaa...
Gahahahaha!
You're a million years too early to beat me!
Go wash...
your butt...
and come back...
later!!!
What? This... malice?
I can feel it... from in there!
Ugh... hurry... run...
Demons from Hell... are... coming...
Gah!
Father! It's me! It's Nakoruru!
What's wrong? What happened?
Nakoruru... is that... you, Nakoruru?
Hurry... run...
From the demon... in the form... of a bear...
Wenkamuy's... servant...
Wenkamuy's servant? ...Huh?
It feels a little warmer...
Perhaps the sea ice has melted and Kamuy Port is usable now...
Kamuy Port is southeast of Kamuy Kotan.
S-sister...
...R-right. Father will come home like always...
He'll definitely come back... Definitely!
That's right... Father will definitely come home...
Definitely!
What... Mamahaha?
You're saying Mamahaha came back
with only the sacred sword Chichiushi?!
Hmm... hmm... I'm worried too.
Nakoruru,
go to the Kamuy Forest at once and search for your father, Rametok!
...Yes.
Take the sacred sword Chichiushi with you!
We're counting on you to find Rametok!
Oh... you want to come with me too?
Hehe... I'm happy, but...
Shikuruu, I'm sorry. Please protect everyone in the village.
All right... come, Shikuruu!
Mamahaha, I'm sorry. This time you protect the village.
What's wrong? You want to come with me?
But...
Hehe, all right then. Mamahaha! Come with me!
Shikuruu, you protect Kamuy Kotan in our place!
...An endless, vast snowfield.
In the land we now call Hokkaido,
amid the great outdoors, in harmony with Mother Nature,
there lived a peaceful people.
The name of this village is Kamuy Kotan.
From this little village,
one girl's fateful journey begins.
...Yes,
it was all fate.
Nakoruru's father was a man named Shirakoru.
Big-hearted and strong... a fine Kamuy warrior who protected nature.
We called Shirakoru Rametok, the brave one,
and we were proud of him...
Nakoruru, now you are the Kamuy warrior.
Become a fine warrior like your father.
Polish not only your skills, but your heart.
We live together with nature.
And the power of evil is eating away at it.
Wenkamuy, the evil gods, are our enemy!
Please, defeat Wenkamuy.
Oh, Nakoruru...
If you're going on a journey, don't forget your herbs.
Oh... sister...
What about Father? Did you find him?
I see... so Father... still hasn't been found.
...No... no... that's a lie... a lie!
That's awful! Sister!
Waaah!
Rimururu just ran off into the back woods in a big hurry.
I think she might have been crying...
Nakoruru, why don't you go check on her?
Rimururu...
147.question: What will you do?

pages: Rimururu... I understand how you feel, but you can't cry forever.
...If you do, Father
won't be able to return to nature in peace...
We're the children of Father, the one they called the brave...
Right, Rimururu...?
We have to become strong like Father.
We can't stay sad forever.
Come on, Rimururu, show me a happy smile.
Rimururu... you poor thing...
There, don't cry anymore...
Father is with nature now, and he'll always
be watching over us... right?
...I understand, sister. ...I won't cry anymore!
You understand... Rimururu.
Rimururu, no!
I'm going to defeat the demons ravaging nature.
...You stay here!
I can fight too!
You've been teaching me the Shikanna Kamuy sword dance!
Please, take me with you!
What am I going to do... Listen, Rimururu.
We have to protect nature in Father's place.
If you leave the village along with me,
who will protect Kamuy Kotan?
Well then... I'm off!
...Sister, come home soon!
Even brave Rametok couldn't match that demon's servant...
So why were you, Nakoruru, able to defeat it...
Nakoruru, you must discover the reason yourself on your journey.
Listen, winning battles is not the only kind of strength...
Rametok was certainly strong.
...But Nakoruru, in you
I sense a mysterious power...
Perhaps you have a strength
different from Rametok's.
Oh... Nakoruru, is it?
You there, her companions, take good care of Nakoruru!
A demonic darkness that frightens nature...
It's spreading from the west!
Sister... I wonder if she's okay. I'm so worried...
What can I do fer ya?
Anythin' else ya need?
That's plenty fer you.
Sorry, but ya ain't got enough money.
This feller, then?
How much should I forge it?
All right, leave it to me!
Anythin' else ya need?
Nobody can equip this.
Equip it?
Who's gonna equip it?
Which one should I take off?
Yer money's full up.
Looks like ya got nothin' to sell.
Tasty, right? Come again!
You feel fired up!
From what the sailors tell me,
all sorts of strange rumors are going around Edo.
If you're headed to Edo, you'd better be careful.
How's that? Feeling better, right?
You recovered a little stamina!
Do you know the Kamuy training grounds?
Head east out of this port and go north, and you'll find them!
Lots of demons around is rough, huh!
Don't be stingy with your special moves. Use 'em freely!
New power wells up inside!
Your stats rose little by little!
...Hmph!
...Still, it's an eyesore...
I don't like Mizuki acting so high and mighty.
Fffff... Human hunger... human greed...
Death... always close by... Fffff...
My gold is human souls... Fear... despair...
...It grows and grows!
Holy! Sieger!
... Holy Break!
No... that's ancient history now...
These days he's in a heaven with no villains,
probably relaxing and enjoying some fishing.
You lot gonna make fun of me too?
Hmph! I've got no time to waste on you!
Go on... get out of here!
Yes!
Oh yes, Lord Holy left something with me for you.
He told me to give this to you...
Lord Holy called it the Key of Mu.
Was it good? It'll pump up your muscles!
You recovered a little stamina!
They're building a bridge north of town,
but there's a strange rumor.
They say whoever picks up gold there loses their life...
Scary, huh?
Oh, you're broke? Well, can't be helped.
Sigh, I want to show off my cooking...
... Stupid...
It's said to be the key to a labyrinth on the ancient continent of Mu...
He said you'd understand once you had it... that it would surely help.
That's what he told me.
Where is Lord Holy?
... Lucky... me...
Neigh! (Nothing beats a drink after a hard day's work!)
Bwihihin! (Dealing with humans wears me out!)
Brrrrrn! (My name is Man o' War!)
Brrrrr... (Autographs later, okay?)
